name: real-forwards-blank
sample: Slate of 2026-11-02, 4 games. Each % compares that game with the skater's own season per game before it, that slate and later games excluded, with 3+ prior GP; xG% is pooled. name: real-goalies-blank
sample: Slate of 2026-11-02, 4 games. STD is each goalie's appearances before that slate, that slate and later games excluded, with 3+ prior GP: per appearance, with SV% and GAA pooled. SV% changes in points of save percentage, GAA and GSAx in goals, the rest in %. GSAx is NST xG against less NST goals against; it prints — until NST has that goalie's row
